osmTags.inscription:
Nesta casa viveu 
Maria Severa Onofriana 
considerada na época a expressão 
sublime do fado
Faleceu em 30-11-1846 com 26 anos de idade
Lisboa 3-6-89
Fidalgo e capitão do exército de Afonso Henriques, autor de feitos notáveis na Batalha de Ourique, teve acção preponderante na conquista de Lisboa em 1147.

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Mapped outline, terrain and present-day surroundings from open data. No historic reconstruction.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:way/98307886 historic=castle Q10344003 4 m from ledger point
present-day buildings capped: kept the 120 nearest the outline centre of 472 mapped (trace size budget); the rest of the town is not drawn
roads capped: kept the 150 longest of 311 mapped (trace size budget); minor lanes are not drawn
origin moved 5 m from the ledger point to the centre of the mapped site
13 mapped path(s) meet closed wall lines (candidate openings for T2; not drawn)
